metadata.overview: One mining pool account set, read through the pool's own API by the vendor worker's pool service (device opt `kind`: emcd, spiderpool or foundry).

telemetry.name: hashrate
telemetry.description: Current pool-side hashrate across configured accounts.

telemetry.name: estimated_earnings
telemetry.description: Previous UTC day mining earnings, used as an estimate for today.

telemetry.name: stats
telemetry.description: Per-account rows of the last poll: { ts, stats: [{ username, hashrate, balance, ... }] }.

telemetry.name: stats_history
telemetry.description: Stored polls between `start` and `end` (ms): [{ ts, stats: [...] }].
